name: alert
description: Displays a message with an optional action.

name: alert-dialog
description: Asks the user to confirm or cancel a consequential action.

name: autocomplete
description: Suggests and filters values as a user types.

name: avatar
description: Displays an image or fallback for a person or entity.

name: badge
description: Labels a status, category, or count.

name: breadcrumb
description: Shows the current page within a hierarchy.

name: button
description: Triggers an action or navigates to another page.

name: calendar
description: Displays and selects dates in one or more calendar months.

name: checkbox
description: Lets a user select or clear an option.

name: checkbox-group
description: Coordinates selection across a group of checkboxes.

name: collapsible
description: Shows and hides a panel from a trigger.

name: combobox
description: Selects one or more values from a filterable collection.

name: command
description: Presents searchable commands in a panel or dialog.

name: context-menu
description: Opens a menu at the pointer position for contextual actions.

name: dialog
description: Displays focused content in a modal or non-modal overlay.

name: drawer
description: Presents draggable overlay content from an edge of the viewport.

name: empty
description: Explains an empty state and its next actions.

name: field
description: Connects a form control with its label, help text, and errors.

name: fieldset
description: Groups related form fields under a shared legend.

name: form
description: Coordinates form submission and field errors.

name: frame
description: Frames related content with a header and footer.

name: group
description: Joins related controls into one visual group.

name: hugeicons-icon
description: Renders official Hugeicons data during SSR and client hydration.

name: input
description: Collects a single line of user input.

name: input-group
description: Combines an input or textarea with inline and block addons.

name: menu
description: Presents actions, links, and nested choices from a trigger.

name: meter
description: Shows a scalar measurement within a known range.

name: number-field
description: Collects and adjusts a locale-aware numeric value.

name: otp-field
description: Collects a one-time code across a group of input slots.

name: pagination
description: Provides links for moving through a paged collection.

name: popover
description: Displays interactive content beside a trigger or anchor.

name: preview-card
description: Previews linked content when its trigger is hovered or focused.

name: progress
description: Shows progress toward completing a task.

name: radio-group
description: Lets a user choose one option from a set.

name: scroll-area
description: Adds custom scrollbars to overflowing content.

name: select
description: Chooses a value from a popup list.

name: sheet
description: Displays overlay content from a chosen side of the viewport.

name: sidebar
description: Builds responsive application navigation with collapsible desktop and mobile modes.

name: skeleton
description: Reserves space while content is loading.

name: slider
description: Selects one or more values within a range.

name: spinner
description: Indicates that an operation is in progress.

name: switch
description: Turns a setting on or off.

name: table
description: Displays structured data in rows and columns.

name: tabs
description: Switches between related panels in the same region.

name: toast
description: Displays transient status and action feedback.

name: toggle
description: Switches a single control between pressed and unpressed states.

name: toggle-group
description: Groups related toggle controls with shared selection behavior.

name: toolbar
description: Groups controls with coordinated keyboard navigation.

name: tooltip
description: Shows a short description when a trigger is hovered or focused.
